publicReleaseNotes: Uptime 0.1.2 follows the public 0.1.1 security fix for local development server file exposure. This candidate adds startup configuration diagnostics, declares sessionless public paths with estimated per-path rate limits, and adds operator erasure with a durable anonymised audit record. The audit record is included in portable product archives; erasure fences later restores when the source erasure journal is supplied. It also adds independent watches and runner vantages: per-runner keys with assigned probes, failure agreement across network vantages and canaries, a runner notice and owner email when the console loses runner contact, an optional external heartbeat ping, a weekly healthy digest, and Resend and Cloudflare mail adapters beside SendGrid. Monitors carried over from 0.1.1 keep their previous failure-agreement rule until they are saved again. The root dependency graph resolves sharp 0.35.5, undici 7.29.1 and source-map-js 1.2.2. These source changes and dependency fixes do not establish hosted operation, recipient acceptance, or closure of alerts in copied Base development manifests.
